title: Romeo and Juliet
author: William Shakespeare
premise: In Verona two families are locked in an old feud. Romeo, a Montague, slips into a Capulet feast and falls for Juliet, the daughter of his family’s enemies.

moments.title: The masked feast
moments.happened: Romeo crashes the Capulet party. He and Juliet fall in love before learning who the other is.
alternatives: Tybalt throws Romeo out at once

moments.title: The balcony
moments.happened: Juliet speaks her love aloud, not knowing Romeo hears. They agree to marry.

moments.title: The secret wedding
moments.happened: Friar Laurence marries them in secret, hoping it will end the feud.
alternatives: The Friar refuses to marry them

moments.title: The street fight
moments.happened: Tybalt kills Mercutio. Romeo kills Tybalt in revenge and is banished from Verona.

moments.title: The Friar’s potion
moments.happened: Facing a forced marriage to Paris, Juliet takes a potion that will make her seem dead.
alternatives: Juliet tells her father the truth

moments.title: The letter that never arrives
moments.happened: The Friar’s letter explaining the plan never reaches Romeo. He hears only that Juliet is dead.
alternatives: Romeo waits a day before leaving

moments.title: The tomb
moments.happened: Romeo reaches the tomb believing Juliet dead, moments before she wakes.
alternatives: Paris stops Romeo at the door
